Saylor Direct Credit

Free learning with a separate credit examination. Current Saylor University branding does not by itself establish institutional-origin transfer classification.

Explore Saylor Direct Credit

Choose a degree plan to see where specific courses fit.

Study format
Self-paced preparation and self-scheduled assessment; current FAQ states a 14-day retake wait and three-attempt maximum.
Pricing
Official FAQ lists free study/transcripts and $5 per proctored attempt. Check each credit exam remains available.
Assessments
Pass the designated proctored Direct Credit exam; an ordinary certificate final does not produce the credit recommendation.
Credit type
ACE recommendations for selected Direct Credit courses; ordinary completion certificates are insufficient.
Transfer and enrollment details

How the credit works

ACE recommendations for selected Direct Credit courses; ordinary completion certificates are insufficient.

Before enrolling

  • Start with your degree plan to see the proposed receiving course or requirement.
  • Review any course-specific enrollment, equipment or assessment steps shown in your plan.
  • University decisions about your own records remain separate from published course matches.
